capabilities.name: Base/table/field CRUD (custom schema)
capabilities.verify: manage_flowtable_table + manage_flowtable_field skills (src/lib/modules/flowtable-module.ts) create/rename/delete tables and columns; UI at src/pages/admin/FlowtablePage.tsx supports base/table/field builder (FIELD_TYPES list, add/edit dialogs).

capabilities.name: Row CRUD
capabilities.verify: manage_flowtable_record skill (create/update/delete/get) + FlowtablePage grid/list/kanban views with inline edit via useCreateRecord/useUpdateRecord/useDeleteRecords hooks.

capabilities.name: Filter/sort/search records
capabilities.verify: query_flowtable skill supports filters[], search, order_by, count_by; FlowtablePage has Filter/ArrowUpDown UI controls and saved FlowtableViewConfig/FlowtableViewFilter.

capabilities.name: Link/lookup/rollup fields between tables
capabilities.verify: manage_flowtable_field supports type link/lookup/rollup with validated options (via_link_field, source_link_field, agg); query_flowtable resolve_links/resolve_computed expand relations. UI FIELD_TYPES includes link-style types in FlowtablePage.

capabilities.name: CSV import/export
capabilities.verify: FlowtablePage.tsx imports papaparse (Papa) and exposes Download/Upload icons for CSV import (auto field creation from header row per docs/modules/flowtable.md) and export.
capabilities.notes: Differentiator vs Odoo Studio, which has no lightweight ad-hoc CSV-to-table import.

capabilities.name: Push rows to CRM (leads/companies)
capabilities.verify: usePushToCrmLeads hook wired in FlowtablePage.tsx (Send icon action); flowtable-module.ts docs describe 'push to CRM as leads or companies' bridge.
capabilities.notes: Differentiator: staging-sheet-to-CRM bridge has no Odoo Studio equivalent.

capabilities.name: Multiple views (grid/list/kanban)
capabilities.verify: FlowtablePage.tsx imports LayoutGrid, List, Rows3 icons and FlowtableViewConfig persists per-table view state (20260712140000_flowtable-view-config.sql migration).

capabilities.name: Assign rows to platform users
capabilities.verify: manage_flowtable_field type 'user' with role_filter option; query_flowtable resolve_links expands to {id, display, email}; useTeamProfiles hook feeds an assignee picker in FlowtablePage.tsx.

capabilities.name: Automations on record change (e.g. Studio automated actions)
capabilities.verify: No AutomationSeed exported from flowtable-module.ts and no automation-rule UI in FlowtablePage.tsx.
capabilities.notes: Odoo Studio ships 'Automated Actions' triggered on record write; Flowtable has no equivalent hook into the automation engine yet.

capabilities.name: Public form view for external data collection
capabilities.verify: No public/share route found for flowtable tables (only /admin/flowtable); compare to Forms module which owns public form submission instead.
capabilities.notes: Odoo Studio lets you publish a form view; Flowtable currently has no shareable public entry form (use the separate Forms module as a workaround).

capabilities.name: Per-base/table sharing & permissions
capabilities.verify: No sharing/collaborator UI found in FlowtablePage.tsx; access appears to be all-or-nothing via module enablement, not per-base ACLs.
capabilities.notes: Odoo Studio-built apps inherit granular record rules; Flowtable bases have no visible per-base ACL control.
